services.desc: Celebrate your special occasions at the stately Giddings Stone Mansion. Built in 1870, the estate has hosted many of the region’s grandest events for nearly 150 years. The grounds of the Giddings Stone Mansion make the perfect backdrop for special events and social gatherings. The venue can accommodate smaller, intimate parties such as baby showers, and all the way to larger events such as weddings. Imagine your perfect gathering among rich architectural details and spacious landscaped grounds. You and your guests will savor the gracious historic atmosphere, and you’ll leave with unique and lasting memories. The Giddings Stone Mansion has eleven rooms, five bathrooms, and broad verandas
